instruction: I prefer an underline cursor in the terminal instead of the default block cursor. Change the terminal cursor shape to underline permanently so it persists after reboot.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.write('gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.Legacy.Profile:/org/gnome/terminal/legacy/profiles:/:$(gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.ProfilesList default | tr -d "'")/ cursor-shape'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter')
